ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white high-intensity regions occupy the distal 50-60% of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated centrally around the notch and extends along the trailing edge, with fine-grained dark mottling interspersed within the white regions of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 85 degrees and high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations observed along the entire visible trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations increases significantly toward the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge lobes, sweeping upward toward the distal tips, which exhibit sharp, slightly hooked terminations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible within the high-intensity white region of the right lobe, particularly toward the tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three distinct, near-parallel dark linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the distal white region of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear rake marks on the right lobe and minor irregular chipping/notching on the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe suggesting past physical trauma.
